project.title: THE LAST PROMISE
project.production_notes: 2D composited anime animatic/pre-vis using reference-locked keyframes, procedural VFX layers, facial lip-sync/blink rigging, synthesized score/SFX, and Hindi TTS dialogue (external ComfyUI/GPU cel-diffusion models unavailable in sandbox).

characters.name: Kai
lock_traits: High-collar black jacket over dark charcoal tee
Dark trousers and silver geometric diamond pendant

characters.name: Mira
lock_traits: Long flowing silver-white hair with side braid
Royal-blue bodice bow, waist sash, and trailing ribbon

scenes.title: The Rain-Soaked Shrine Ruins
scenes.music_cue: D-minor solo piano + rain + distant thunder

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.hi: तुमने वादा किया था मीरा… कि इस बारिश के पार, हम फिर मिलेंगे।
dialogue.en: You promised me, Mira… that beyond this rain, we would meet again.

scenes.title: The Apparition in Silver and Violet
scenes.music_cue: Piano + warm ascending strings + crystalline chime

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.hi: मैं वक्त की कैद से सिर्फ़ एक पल के लिए लौटी हूँ, काई… तुम्हें बचाने।
dialogue.en: I have returned from the prison of time for just one moment, Kai… to save you.

scenes.title: The Shattering Curse
scenes.music_cue: Urgent orchestral percussion + brass/string ostinato + lightning impact

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.hi: चाहे दुनिया टूट जाए, अब मैं तुम्हें जाने नहीं दूँगा!
dialogue.en: Even if the world shatters, I won't let you go again!

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.hi: काई, मेरा हाथ थामे रहो—अँधेरा अभी खत्म नहीं हुआ!
dialogue.en: Kai, keep holding my hand—the darkness isn't over yet!

scenes.title: The Sacrifice & The Last Promise
scenes.music_cue: Soaring tragic strings transitioning to delicate celesta & piano

dialogue.speaker: mira
dialogue.hi: वादा करो काई… जब ये चेरी ब्लॉसम फिर खिलेंगे, तुम मुझे भूलोगे नहीं।
dialogue.en: Promise me, Kai… when these cherry blossoms bloom again, you won't forget me.

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.hi: मेरा आखिरी वादा है, मीरा… मैं इंतज़ार करूँगा।
dialogue.en: It is my last promise, Mira… I will wait for you.

scenes.title: Sakura Dawn & The Last Promise
scenes.music_cue: Warm sunrise piano resolution + soft sakura wind

dialogue.speaker: kai
dialogue.hi: हर सुबह की रोशनी में… तुम हमेशा मेरे साथ हो।
dialogue.en: In the light of every dawn… you are always with me.
